CareMaintenance.metaDescription: Official guide for daily cleaning, stain removal, and maintaining the timeless beauty of Persis Quartz surfaces.
CareMaintenance.title: Care & Maintenance
CareMaintenance.subtitle: Lasting Beauty with Minimal Maintenance
CareMaintenance.intro: Persis Quartz surfaces are engineered with ultra-dense, non-porous physical properties offering superior resistance to everyday wear, stains, and impact. No sealing, waxing, or repolishing is required.
CareMaintenance.firstCleanDesc: After installation, clean the surface thoroughly with warm water, mild soap, and a soft microfiber cloth or non-abrasive sponge, then dry completely.
CareMaintenance.dailyCareDesc: Simply use warm water and a few drops of mild neutral dishwashing liquid. Rinse thoroughly and wipe dry with a soft cloth to avoid hard water limescale.
CareMaintenance.stainsDesc: Clean spills like coffee, tea, and oils promptly. For dried residue, apply a mild non-abrasive cleaner in gentle circular motions, rinse with clean water, and dry.
CareMaintenance.scratchProtDesc: While quartz has a Mohs hardness of 7, always use cutting boards and avoid dragging heavy, sharp metallic utensils directly across the surface.
CareMaintenance.heatProtDesc: Never place boiling pots, hot skillets, or oven trays directly onto the quartz slab. Always use trivets or heat-resistant protective pads.
CareMaintenance.chemicalsProtDesc: Avoid contact with strong solvents, paint strippers, trichloroethane, concentrated hydrochloric acid, or high-alkaline degreasers. Rinse immediately if spilled.
CareMaintenance.edgesProtDesc: Avoid high-impact blows with heavy pots or equipment against fabricated edges, corners, and sink cutouts.
CareMaintenance.ctaDesc: Our technical and architectural support teams are always available to assist with your project specifications.

About.visionDesc2: Beginning our journey in Shahrekord, we harness advanced engineering and skilled specialists to craft world-class surfaces. Persis Quartz blends industrial strength with refined aesthetics, delivering timeless surfaces to modern living spaces.
About.craftsmanshipTitle: Inspired by Nature, Crafted for Life
About.craftsmanshipDesc: Every Persis Quartz slab reflects natural majesty, precision-engineered for modern living. From dramatic Calacatta veining to minimal solid tones, our collections elevate residential and commercial environments. We perceive stone not as a material, but as an architectural canvas.
